errors.evidence: The x-axis represents the model number, as indicated by the context of "30个模型" (30 models), not the sample number.
While TP stands for True Positives, it is a count, not a unit itself. It is awkward and unconventional to state the unit is 'TP'.
The minimum value of the solid line dips below 5900 at x=3 and x=13, so the stated range is incorrect.
At x=10, the value on the solid line is approximately 6200, not 6100.
At x=15, the value on the solid line is approximately 6300, not 6400.
The peak of the solid line at x=20 is visibly below the 6500 grid line, approximately at 6480. A value of 6550 is a significant overestimation.
The dashed line is visibly above the 6500 grid line, at a constant value of approximately 6550, not 6500.
